description:
NinjaTrader 8 is open on the Windows desktop with the Control Center visible. Real daily OHLCV data for MSFT (Microsoft Corporation) from January 2023 to December 2024 (502 trading days from Yahoo Finance) is available in the NinjaTrader data directory.

Your task:
1. Open the Strategy Analyzer: from the Control Center menu, click 'New' then select 'Strategy Analyzer'.
2. In the Strategy Analyzer window, click the Strategy dropdown and select 'SampleMACrossOver' (a built-in sample strategy).
3. Set the instrument to 'MSFT'.
4. Set the time period: Start date = January 1, 2023 and End date = December 31, 2024.
5. Set the bar type to 'Daily'.
6. Click the 'Run' button to execute the backtest.
7. Once the backtest completes, the performance results (Total Net Profit, Max Drawdown, etc.) should be visible in the results panel.
